T: The bank job was easy. Leaving New York is hard.
D: Three bank robbers can't find their way out of New York.
P: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.
S: Grimm's disguise for the bank job
Cut the tops off cherry tomatoes, scoop, fill with feta whipped with basil and lemon, a basil leaf on top. A red nose for every guest.
so close to getting out of the city

Oven-crisp chicken wings tossed in chilli, lime and honey butter, finished with coriander and extra lime. Pat 1kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Roast on a rack at 220C for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through. Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the zest and juice of 2 limes. Toss the wings through and scatter with coriander.
Flaky golden pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, thyme and scotch bonnet, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
M: for a city that won't let you leave
Kaiser rolls with sliced turkey, Swiss, lettuce, tomato, mayo and mustard, salt and pepper, wrapped tight in paper and cut in half.
the final stop before the plane
Franks simmered with onion, then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and diced onion.
W: Vanilla sponge split and filled with jam and buttercream, covered in white buttercream, a clown face piped on with a maraschino cherry for the nose.
K: a toast to finally leaving New York

Bourbon muddled with mint, lemon and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig. In a shaker, muddle 12 mint leaves and 4 lemon wedges with 40ml sugar syrup. Add 180ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice. Top with a fat sprig of mint and serve with short straws.

edition.tagline: The bank job was easy. Leaving New York is hard.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.

s.note: Cherry tomatoes filled with basil and lemon whipped feta.
s.how: Cut the tops off 24 cherry tomatoes and scoop out the seeds. Blitz 150g feta with a handful of basil, the zest of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Pipe into the tomatoes and top each with a small basil leaf. A red nose for every guest.

s.note: Oven-crisp chicken wings tossed in chilli, lime and honey butter, finished with coriander and extra lime.
s.how: Pat 1kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Roast on a rack at 220C for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through. Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the zest and juice of 2 limes. Toss the wings through and scatter with coriander.

m.note: Turkey and Swiss kaiser rolls wrapped tight in paper.
m.how: Split 4 kaiser rolls, spread with 80g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp mustard. Fill with 400g sliced turkey, 8 slices Swiss cheese, shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes, and season with salt and pepper. Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.

w.note: Jam sponge in white buttercream with a piped clown face and cherry nose.
w.how: Split a 400g sponge cake and fill with 100g raspberry jam. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and spread all over the cake. Tint a little leftover buttercream and pipe a clown face on top, then press a maraschino cherry in for the nose.

d.note: Bourbon muddled with mint, lemon and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig.
d.how: In a shaker, muddle 12 mint leaves and 4 lemon wedges with 40ml sugar syrup. Add 180ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice. Top with a fat sprig of mint and serve with short straws.
